newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangzhou Inv redeems bonds for US$35mln.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Inv redeems bonds for US$35mln.

text.p: Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd said on Monday its wholly-owned Guangzhou Investment Convertible Bond (1993) Ltd unit would redeem all outstanding 4.5 percent convertible guaranteed bonds due 1998 for US$35.26 million.

The company said the redemption would be financed by internal resources or third party financing. "The reason of the early redemption is to save future interest expenses," company chairman Zhang Bohua said in a statement.
Guangzhou Investment said its unit intended to redeem the bonds, with a nominal value of US$10,000, at their principal amount together with accrued interest of US$83.75 per bond on March 21.
The principal oustanding amount of unconverted bonds amounted to about US$34.97 million as of February 12. The conversion price of the bonds is HK$2.40 per share.
Shares of Guangzhou Investment closed at HK$3.475 per share on Friday.
